propositions: FAIL remediation guidance omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence, causing operators to attempt futile ticket-comment-only retries on untagged criteria.

ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md deliberately classify untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable; the remediation guidance contradicts this by implying external ticket evidence alone will suffice on retry.
The generic FAIL guidance must affirmatively distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact tag prerequisite.

Strengthened remediation interface test requires [operator-attested] tag, distinction between evidence channels, and statement that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comment alone.
